method: Reachable free grid from the historical origin; conservative swept box collision checks; jittered, spatially spread random selection without replacement.
height_distribution: uniform installation-height assumption, not sensor error or measured hardware tolerance
scene_split_rule: Different positions in one scene are correlated viewpoints, not independent train/test environments. Split by scene family/source before assigning viewpoints.
corridor_floor_provenance: L-shaped wall layout in scene_geometry_v2.py; clipped to the terrain boundary. Mesh collision checks apply to each variant.
